sections.content:
Interesting! After pressing RIGHT 3 times, the cup is now tilted in the opposite direction: the band runs from (21,38) at the upper left to (37,40) at the lower right. The opening now faces right (the tip at (37,40) is at the lower right). Wait, let me look: the band is at rows 21–37, and the columns shift from 34–38 (row 21) to 36–40 (row 37). So the band is tilted like "\" (upper left to lower right). The liquid is in rows 21–33, on the upper-left side of the band... the liquid cells: row 23: p at 36; row 24: p at 35–37; ... row 33: p at 36–37. Hmm, the liquid is along the upper part of the band.
Wait, but the batch result showed no_impact: True — the explore batch stopped at the first no_impact. board_changed: True is confusing. Let me check the transitions: 3 actions were executed (steps 10→13). The batch result shows no_impact: True — maybe the last action (the 3rd RIGHT) was no_impact? But the cup clearly changed from the 90° "\" tilt to... wait, the previous state at 90°: the band was from (21,24) at the upper right to (37,22) at the lower left — that's a "/" tilt. Now: from (21,38) at the upper left to (37,40) at the lower right — a "\" tilt.
Hmm, wait, that's weird. At 90° the band was "/" (upper right to lower left). After RIGHT×3, the band is "\" (upper left to lower right). If RIGHT rotates clockwise: 90° → 135°? But I thought the tilt was capped at 90°. Maybe the cap doesn't exist and the tilt can continue past 90°! At 135° (i.e., 90° + 45°), the band would be "\"... let me verify: at 0° the cup is upright (opening down). At 45° (after LEFT): the band is... in the previous frame at 45°, the band ran from (21,25) at the upper right to (37,22) at the lower left — "/" — the opening faced lower left. At 90°: the band is "/" from (21,24) to (37,22)? Hmm, actually at 90° the band looked more vertical.
Now, after RIGHT×3 from 90°: if RIGHT decreases the tilt: 90→45→0→-45. At -45°: the band should be "\" (mirror image of +45°). The current band is "\" — consistent with -45°! And the opening faces lower right (the tip at (37,40)). The liquid pools on the upper-left side. ✓.
But wait, no_impact: True in the batch result — maybe the 3rd RIGHT (0→-45) was counted as no_impact because... hmm, but the board did change (the cup rotated). Actually, maybe no_impact refers to the last action in the batch, and the batch stopped early? The result says 3 actions were executed (steps 10→13). Let me check the transitions to see which action was no_impact.
Actually, the batch result I printed was last_action_result after the batch — it reflects the last action (the 3rd RIGHT). no_impact: True but board_changed: True? That's contradictory. Maybe no_impact means "no impact on gameplay" (the cup's rotation is cosmetic?) — no, that's not it. Let me look at the transitions.
In any case, the current state: the cup is at -45° (or 315°), the vessel is unchanged (65 p's, the staircase is still in the lower left).
Now, the key test: press SPACE at -45° and see what gets stamped. Hypothesis: a mirrored staircase (1,2,3,4,5) fills the empty triangle in the lower right → the vessel is completely filled.
Wait, but first let me double-check the empty region: row 39: W at columns 32–36 (5 W's), row 40: W at 31–36 (6), row 41: W at 30–36 (7), row 42: W at 29–36 (8), row 43: W at 28–36 (9). The mirrored staircase (from the left: 5,6,7,8,9 p's) would fill exactly those W's!
Let me press SPACE and check.
